title: Candidate Change
description: One unit the loop operates on: a versioned, reversible, attributed mutation to the product under test, proposed with a falsifiable hypothesis. The proposer emits these; the deterministic selector and experiment engine decide their fate.

author.description: Autonomous proposals are ai_proposer; objective/grader/corpus changes must be human (see safety_and_governance.md).

hypothesis.description: What the change is predicted to do, stated falsifiably so the selector can check whether it worked AND whether it worked for the claimed reason.

target_capability.description: The one capability this change primarily targets. Invariant: target_capability MUST be a member of change.capabilities_touched (enforced at offline_scoring).

target_metric_code.description: The primary metric this change aims to move. VALIDATION CONTRACT: the selector resolves this against ../telemetry/metric_catalog.md at implemented->offline_scoring; an unresolvable code (e.g. a typo) auto-rejects the candidate — a typo'd target would otherwise silently fail hypothesis_confirmed and mis-route to human review.

target_scenario_ids.description: The scenarios expected to improve most.

expected_magnitude.description: Optional predicted effect size; compared to ledger offline_result.observed_target_delta. A big aggregate gain via an unhypothesized path (low target_attribution_share) is treated as suspect.

guards_to_watch.description: The paired counter-metrics from the catalog that must NOT regress. Also resolved against the catalog at offline_scoring; unresolvable codes auto-reject.

rationale.description: Why the proposer believes this will work; grounded in the scorecard/ledger/adversarial candidate that motivated it.

change_type.description: weights_PROHIBITED is listed only so a proposer attempting to tune the objective is rejected explicitly, not silently.

summary.description: One line a human reviewer can act on.

artifact_ref.description: Branch/commit/flag identifying the change. Must be atomically revertible.

reversible.description: Must be true to advance past offline. A change that cannot be cleanly reverted is rejected.

capabilities_touched.description: A CLAIM by the proposer, NOT authoritative. The authoritative risk_tier is derived from a static analysis of the diff (see ../risk_tier_derivation.md); this field is cross-checked against that derivation and an under-declaration is auto-rejected and escalated as a firewall-evasion signal. Also seeds segment monitoring.

mid_engagement_safe.description: True if rolling this back partway through a couple's 12-18 month engagement leaves no orphaned state. Required for production stages.

risk_tier.description: 0 = cosmetic/ranking (offline+canary, auto). 1 = flow/non-binding tools (adds shadow + human notify). 2 = money/guest-comms/bookings/PII (adds human approval gate + slow ramp). 3 = objective/graders/corpus/spend-model/legal — PROHIBITED for ai_proposer. See safety_and_governance.md.

depends_on.description: candidate_ids this builds on; prevents stacking unvalidated changes.

status.description: Current position in the stage machine (loop_architecture.md).
